subject: MercuryMart: PO format / remit split & VAT handling for EU merchant portal
messages:
From: Agnieszka Nowak <agnieszka.nowak@mercurymart.pl>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@mercurymart.pl>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Redwood vendor registration + PO and remit details for EU portal

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — MercuryMart is moving fast and procurement is starting to onboard platform vendors to our merchant portal. Before we finalize, two quick items our AP team needs from Redwood so we can add you as a vendor and start sending POs: 

- A copy of Redwood's EU VAT certificate (we need documentation for tax validation).
- Confirmation whether you can accept POs that use a split remit (one PO line billed to a UK entity, remainder to IE), and whether you can handle reverse-charge invoicing when applicable.

I've attached a one-page PO sample from our portal that shows the fields our system will include. A few of our internal fields are non-standard (we surface a buyer cost-center and delivery hub code). Can you provide the AP onboarding packet Redwood requires for vendor registration (bank remit instructions, EFT mandate, W-8/W-9 equivalent if needed, and a preferred invoice template)?

Our timeline: portal enrollment this month with first PO expected 07/05. If you need a sandbox submission to validate routing, we can enable test POs.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so procurement can proceed.

Thanks,
Agnieszka Nowak
Director, Strategic Procurement
MercuryMart Group

Attachments: MercuryMart_PO_sample.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Agnieszka Nowak <agnieszka.nowak@mercurymart.pl>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T11:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration + PO and remit details for EU portal

Hi Agnieszka — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: we can be onboarded into the portal this month, and Redwood can accept split remit scenarios and support reverse-charge invoices where the law requires it.

Attached is our standard AP onboarding packet (Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) and a PDF copy of our EU VAT certificate (Redwood_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf). A few notes to help map fields in your sample PO: 

- Bank remit: we support single-account EFT across EU (IBAN/SEPA) and can provide an AP contact for remittance reconciliation if MercuryMart wants a separate remit reference.
- PO fields: our finance system expects a PO number, invoice line-item SKU or description, tax amount (VAT line separate), and a 6-digit cost center mapping if present. We can accept an extra 'hub_code' field as a free-text reference; it will be retained in the invoice PDF but not used for posting.
- Split remit: we can split invoice lines to different legal entities if MercuryMart's PO references distinct legal-entity IDs. If the PO is a single legal entity with split payment instructions, we will need a signed EFT mandate confirming payment splits.

If you prefer, we can submit a test invoice to your sandbox this week. Laura (cc) manages Redwood finance and will confirm the specifics on split-entity accounting/reconciliation. Vivek (cc) can help coordinate any SSO/API keys required for automated PO ingestion.

Action items: 
1) Laura: please confirm the acceptance criteria for split-remit POs and whether we need a separate vendor ID per legal entity.
2) Agnieszka: if you can enable sandbox POs, send the test endpoint and credentials.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, Redwood_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf

From: ProcureOps <procureops@mercurymart.pl>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T08:22:00+02:00
Subject: RE: Redwood vendor registration + PO and remit details for EU portal

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks for the packet. A few clarifying points from our AP engineer after reviewing your onboarding form and VAT doc: 

- Our portal emits a PO with two remit lines for international merchants (payment split across MercuryMart PL and MercuryMart IE). The PO will also include a UBL extension with buyer_cost_center and hub_code. Will Redwood's invoice PDF retain both remit line references so our reconciliations match automated parsing?
- For reverse-charge: our tax team noted that if Redwood invoices net-of-VAT (reverse charge), they require a textual VAT-note on the invoice and the supplier's EU-VAT number must be present. Your PDF has the number but the onboarding form doesn't indicate where to place the 'VAT reverse-charge note' on the invoice template.
- Finally, we need Redwood to sign a short EFT mandate confirming the split remit flow for the first two POs. Can you return a signed mandate by 2026-06-23?

Attached is an annotated PO sample with our portal's XML field names. Also included is a DocuSign link for the EFT mandate.

ProcureOps
MercuryMart AP Operations

Attachments: MercuryMart_PO_sample_annotated.xml, MercuryMart_EFT_Mandate.docx
Links: https://docusign.com/signer/MERC-3421

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Agnieszka Nowak <agnieszka.nowak@mercurymart.pl>, ProcureOps <procureops@mercurymart.pl>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T14:03:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration + PO and remit details for EU portal

Hi Agnieszka / ProcureOps — looping in Redwood finance to confirm. Quick replies: 

- Invoice formatting: we will include the portal 'hub_code' and 'buyer_cost_center' as additional fields in our invoice PDF (they will be visible in the header/meta area). That should satisfy automated parsing.
- Reverse-charge note: we will add a configurable VAT note block to our EU invoices; the text will follow your team's recommended language.
- Split remit & vendor IDs: Redwood prefers one vendor record per legal entity for accounting clarity. For your split-pay POs we can either: 1) request MercuryMart create two POs tied to the distinct legal-entity IDs, or 2) accept a single PO with explicit remit instructions and a signed EFT mandate. Option (1) is cleaner; option (2) is acceptable short-term with the mandate.

Next steps we suggest:
1) Agnieszka — enable sandbox POs and send credentials (Jonas/Vivek will pick up).
2) ProcureOps — if option (2) is required immediately, please send the DocuSign EFT mandate; we will countersign by 2026-06-22.
3) Jonas/Vivek — coordinate a 30-min handoff call with ProcureOps to validate the sample PO ingestion and invoice parsing.

I'll countersign the EFT mandate once legal confirms the remit split language (we'll aim end of day 06/22).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
